name: MP3 to MIDI (mp3tomidi.io)
summary: Online MP3 to MIDI converter with AI note detection in the browser.
description: MP3 to MIDI converts an uploaded MP3 into a MIDI file in the browser. A machine-learning model detects notes on the device, so the audio is processed locally and no account is required. A piano roll previews the detected notes and lets you adjust them before downloading the MIDI file.

pricing.label: Free
pricing.note: The site says the first version is a free online converter and does not require an account.

howToUse.title: Upload an MP3
howToUse.description: Drop an MP3 in the browser. The page says there is no signup, the audio stays on your device, and the free conversion accepts files up to 5 minutes.

howToUse.title: Choose the closest audio type
howToUse.description: Select voice, piano, guitar, bass, another solo instrument, a full song, or Not Sure. The page says the preset adjusts detection and does not create separate instrument tracks.

howToUse.title: Preview and download the MIDI
howToUse.description: Compare the audio with the MIDI preview, edit notes in the piano roll, and download the MIDI file.
